verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs claim Claude automatically detects and loads relevant Skills when delegating a task (docs-2, docs-25, gh-9), effectively letting users delegate to the built-in assistant which then invokes specialized capabilities. However, multiple hands-on community reports concretely contradict automatic triggering, describing skills frequently not being invoked even when explicitly named, forcing manual invocation or pasting content into AGENTS.md instead (comm-6, comm-7, comm-9, comm-11, comm-12, comm-14). Missing for 10: reliable automatic delegation without manual workarounds, and independent benchmarks confirming trigger accuracy.
